name: zeroproxy
description: A zero-dependency reverse proxy, HTTP router, static file server, and WebSocket tunnel built entirely on Bun's runtime built-ins.

scripts.reproduce: bun build ./src/index.ts --compile --outfile zeroproxy-build-1 && bun build ./src/index.ts --compile --outfile zeroproxy-build-2 && sha256sum zeroproxy-build-1 zeroproxy-build-2 > BUILD_HASHES.txt && cmp zeroproxy-build-1 zeroproxy-build-2 && echo BYTE-IDENTICAL
